scope: Concrete receiving inputs for P01/G01; development evidence is not operating acceptance

inputs.title: Runtime, dependencies and network
inputs.required_input: Exact target runtime/dependency BOM and support/update owners; allowed registry/advisory/PKI traffic, mirrors and disconnection/freshness limits.

inputs.title: Registry and artifact trust
inputs.required_input: Source/target registries and immutable-copy path; approved signer identity/custody, independently delivered trust root, revocation/time policy and authorized promotion owner.

inputs.title: Secrets, PKI and evidence custody
inputs.required_input: Actual secret/PKI/evidence services and owners; scoped references, bootstrap, rotation, revocation, retention and recoverable key availability.

inputs.title: Repository admission activation
inputs.required_input: Verified numeric GitHub IDs and logins for context/platform/architecture/security/SRE roles; independent reporting identity; default-branch hook installation and observed protection settings.

inputs.title: Alert routing and response
inputs.required_input: Actual receiving route reference, response owner/rota, delivery and acknowledgement evidence, escalation and outage/freshness measurement conditions.

inputs.title: Recovery and retained inventory
inputs.required_input: Complete persisted/configuration/evidence inventory with retention/deletion authority, key recovery dependencies and attributable restore/rollback acceptance; target objectives remain owned decisions.

inputs.title: Support and accessibility baseline
inputs.required_input: Accountable patch/support access owners, selected managed browsers and assistive matrix with receiving checks.
